    "(Tutorial_OpenMM_Pin_atoms)=\n",
    "# Pin atoms\n",
    "\n",
    "*Freezing atom positions by setting their masses to zero in OpenMM simulation systems.*\n",
    "\n",
    "The function {func}`molsysmt.third_party.openmm.forces.pin_atoms` pins selected atoms in place by modifying their particle masses to zero within the OpenMM `System`.\n",
    "\n",
    ":::{versionadded} 1.0.0\n",
    ":::\n",
    "\n",
    ":::{admonition} API documentation\n",
    ":class: dropdown\n",
    "\n",
    "Follow this link for a detailed description of the input arguments, raised errors, and returned objects: {func}`molsysmt.third_party.openmm.forces.pin_atoms`.\n",
    ":::\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "658a7ea3",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Basic usage\n",
    "\n",
    "Let's freeze selected atoms by setting mass to zero:"
   ]
  },

    "import molsysmt as msm\n",
    "\n",
    "molsys = msm.convert(msm.systems['Trp-Cage']['1l2y.h5msm'], to_form='molsysmt.MolSys')\n",
    "force = msm.third_party.openmm.forces.pin_atoms(molsys, selection=[0], force_constant='5000 kJ/(mol*nm**2)', return_force=True)\n",
    "print('Atoms pinned successfully:', type(force))"
